research_question: Under the native M10 25-action contract, do at least two legal non-NOOP UAV-Task allocation actions at the same public decision prefix have repeatable task-energy-deadline consequences, and can public information or a compatible candidate-consequence/world-model feature add predictability?

evidence_for_new_question.interpretation: R/K evidence establishes a descriptive opportunity but not arbitrary allocation consequences; the candidate gate must be rerun on identity-matched native M10 public prefixes before any formal budget.

gates: public baseline then candidate consequence then compatible world-model increment
stop_if: candidate mask cannot be independently reconstructed
fewer than two legal non-NOOP allocation actions
outcome difference requires truth leakage or widened mask
candidate-consequence or world-model input identity is incompatible
